title: Internal Hom comparison between algebraic completion and ideal torsion
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], let $r\geq0$ and $f_1,\ldots,f_r\in A$, and put $I=(f_1,\ldots,f_r)$. In the ordinary derived category $D(A)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], let $C=C_A(f_1,\ldots,f_r;A)$ be the extended alternating localization complex defined in [lem-per-ideal-torsion-cech-computation], with $A$ in degree zero and, for $1\leq p\leq r$, $\prod_{i_1<\cdots<i_p}A_{f_{i_1}\cdots f_{i_p}}$ in degree $p$. For $X\in D(A)$ define $\Lambda_I(X)=R\operatorname{Hom}_A(C,X)$ using [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] on the one-object ringed site. For an $A$-module $N$ let $\Gamma_I(N)=\{x\in N:I^nx=0\text{ for some }n\geq1\}$ [def-sbc-ideal-power-torsion-functor], and let $R\Gamma_I$ be its unbounded right derived functor on $D(A)$, computed termwise on K-injective representatives [def-pur-kinjective-complex] on the one-object ringed site. For all $K,L\in D(A)$ there is an isomorphism in $D(A)$, natural in $K,L$, $$R\operatorname{Hom}_A(\Lambda_I(K),\Lambda_I(L))\cong R\operatorname{Hom}_A(R\Gamma_I(K),R\Gamma_I(L)).$$
